caption: The drawing features a bald eagle with brown wings extended outward and tipped with darker brown; its head is white with yellow on its beak. The eagle is positioned in front of a wooden brown shield-like shape topped with a circular blue area filled with white stars, surrounded by a white cloud-like border. A yellow scroll with greenish shadows wraps around the eagle’s beak and above its head, displaying the text "E PLURIBUS UNUM" in black capital letters, with “E PLURIBUS” on the left and “UNUM” on the right. The eagle’s body is partially covered by a heraldic shield. The top third of the shield is blue with a few visible white stars, while the lower two-thirds are vertically striped in alternating red and white. In its left talon, the eagle grasps a leafy green olive branch, and in its right talon, it holds a bundle of brownish arrows. The entire composition is centered on an off-white or light beige background, and a small black signature or monogram "W." appears at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Eagle Emblem
